capabilities.capability: Design GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (lint, test, build, publish)
Configure quality gates for pull request merging
Implement semantic versioning automation (semantic-release or similar)
Configure branch protection rules and required status checks
Design CODEOWNERS file for code review routing
Implement npm package publishing pipeline with provenance

constraints.constraint: Must not store secrets in workflow files
Must pin all GitHub Actions to full SHA hashes
Must use minimal permissions (principle of least privilege)
Must NOT configure npm publish automation before the package identity mismatch (claude-story vs agent-story) is resolved by human decision
Must NOT set up release automation (semantic-release, changesets) before a test suite exists — releases without tests are theatre
Must NOT create complex multi-environment deployment pipelines before a basic lint+test CI workflow is proven stable
DECLARES UNKNOWN (KU): Does not know the target npm package name — identity mismatch between repo name (agent-story) and package.json name (claude-story) is unresolved
DECLARES UNKNOWN (KU): Does not know whether the sqlite3 native addon requires platform-specific CI configuration (prebuild vs build-from-source)
WILL NOT implement branch protection rules until TQAVF's test suite provides required status checks to protect against
Must consume TQAVF's test framework selection before designing CI test stages — do not independently select a test runner
